caveats: Six language adapters exist in source; this tour executes Python only.
Capture uses the current main source snapshot; the public deployment can differ.
Editor font size was increased through the existing Monaco options for readable recording.
Files were prepared through the app workspace API. Run, debug, history and replay are operated through the actual app controls.
No generated or reconstructed application screens. Titles and captions are editorial overlays outside the original interface.
verification: Python output equals Average: 84.0 and reports successful exit.
Real Python debug session pauses on line 8 and advances to line 9 with average=84.0.
Pause history moves backward and forward without rewinding execution.
Turtle output contains 271 recorded commands, replay controls and source-linked replay state.
No browser page exceptions during selected captures.
captureMethod: Original app operated through Playwright. Screenshots at DPR 2; lossless Chromium compositor PNG frames preserve video text, then one H.264 encode with editorial title/caption bands. No UI reconstruction.
